results.name: modules
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE modules (
  code         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  title        TEXT NOT NULL,
  description  TEXT,
  credits      REAL,
  department   TEXT,
  faculty      TEXT,
  level        INTEGER,
  semesters    TEXT,          -- JSON array, e.g. "[1,2]"
  workload     TEXT,          -- JSON array of hours per activity
  prerequisite TEXT,
  preclusion   TEXT,
  acad_year    TEXT NOT NULL,
  text_hash    TEXT NOT NULL  -- hash of the embedded blob, for skip-on-reingest
, ng INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ng_semesters TEXT, sem1 INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS
  (instr(replace(replace(coalesce(semesters, ''), '[', ','), ']', ','), ',1,') > 0) VIRTUAL, sem2 INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS
  (instr(replace(replace(coalesce(semesters, ''), '[', ','), ']', ','), ',2,') > 0) VIRTUAL, sem3 INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS
  (instr(replace(replace(coalesce(semesters, ''), '[', ','), ']', ','), ',3,') > 0) VIRTUAL, sem4 INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS
  (instr(replace(replace(coalesce(semesters, ''), '[', ','), ']', ','), ',4,') > 0) VIRTUAL, ng_sem1 INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS
  (instr(replace(replace(coalesce(ng_semesters, ''), '[', ','), ']', ','), ',1,') > 0) VIRTUAL, ng_sem2 INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS
  (instr(replace(replace(coalesce(ng_semesters, ''), '[', ','), ']', ','), ',2,') > 0) VIRTUAL, row_hash TEXT, exam_semesters TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', exam_sem1 INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS (instr(exam_semesters, '1') > 0) VIRTUAL, exam_sem2 INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS (instr(exam_semesters, '2') > 0) VIRTUAL, exam_sem3 INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS (instr(exam_semesters, '3') > 0) VIRTUAL, exam_sem4 INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS (instr(exam_semesters, '4') > 0) VIRTUAL, su INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, grading_basis TEXT, workload_hours REAL, prereq_none INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, prereq_cohort_only INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ng_allow INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ng_rules TEXT, exam_dates TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]')

results.name: modules_fts_insert
results.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER modules_fts_insert AFTER INSERT ON modules BEGIN
  INSERT INTO modules_fts(rowid, code, title, description)
  VALUES (new.rowid, new.code, new.title, new.description);
END

results.name: modules_fts_delete
results.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER modules_fts_delete AFTER DELETE ON modules BEGIN
  INSERT INTO modules_fts(modules_fts, rowid, code, title, description)
  VALUES ('delete', old.rowid, old.code, old.title, old.description);
END

results.name: modules_fts_update
results.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER modules_fts_update AFTER UPDATE OF code, title, description ON modules
WHEN old.title IS NOT new.title OR old.description IS NOT new.description OR old.code IS NOT new.code
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO modules_fts(modules_fts, rowid, code, title, description)
  VALUES ('delete', old.rowid, old.code, old.title, old.description);
  INSERT INTO modules_fts(rowid, code, title, description)
  VALUES (new.rowid, new.code, new.title, new.description);
END

results.name: modules_rowid_immutable
results.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER modules_rowid_immutable AFTER UPDATE ON modules
WHEN new.rowid IS NOT old.rowid
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'modules.rowid is immutable: modules_fts is keyed on it');
END
